_comment: ADMIN TRAILER OVERRIDES — edit this file (or use scripts/trailer_admin.py) to control trailers without touching frontend code or the legacy app. Each entry replaces the display candidates for that title. 'candidates' are shown in order after priority sorting; 'excludeTrailers: true' hides all trailers for the title. Fields: videoId (11-char YouTube ID), type (official-trailer | official-teaser | official-clip | fan-made), title (display label), source, channel, verified (bool), lastChecked.

spirited-away.note: Legacy anime record; legacy/index.html cannot be edited, so the trailer is managed here. Verified 2026-08-12 via oEmbed.
